question: The National Defense Fund is governed by an Executive Committee, which is chaired by the:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Prime Minister**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The National Defense Fund is governed by an Executive Committee.
 
• This Executive Committee is chaired by the **Prime Minister of India**.
 
• The fund is used for the welfare of the members of the Armed Forces (including Para Military Forces) and their dependents.
 
• The National Defence Fund also accepts voluntary donations from individuals, organizations, and corporates.
 
• Contributions to the fund are exempt from income tax under Section 80(G) of the Income Tax Act.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The National Defence Fund was set up in the year **1962**.
 
• It aims to take charge of voluntary donations in cash and kind received for promotion of the national defense effort, and to decide on their utilization.
 
• The fund is entirely dependent on voluntary contributions from the public and does not get any budgetary support.
 
• Donations can be made online as well through the official government portal.
 
• The management of the fund is subject to audit by the Comptroller and Auditor General of India.
